\begin{equation} \int _{\Omega } \bigl[(a^{ij}D_j u+b^i u)D_i v-(c^i D_i u+d u)v\bigr]\, dx =-\int _{\Omega } g v\, dx \end{equation}

for every $v\in C_0^1(\Omega )$. If the coefficients and $g$ are sufficiently smooth and $u\in C^2(\Omega )$, the weak identity gives the classical equation.
